name: Dread or Dead Surf School
summary: A family-run surf shop and school on Hastings Main Road, teaching surfing in Barbados since 1995. Instructors take you to the break that suits the day's waves and your level, from Brandons and Dover to Freights Bay. The shop also runs guided surf tours, stand up paddle sessions in Carlisle Bay and rents out more than 200 boards.
standouts: Surf school and shop established in 1995
Group lessons capped at 4 students per instructor
Over 200 rental surfboards, with delivery to any home or hotel on the island
In-house surfboard and SUP repair shop

contact.address: Dread or Dead Shop, Hastings Main Road, Christ Church, Barbados

trips.title: Beginner Surf Lessons
trips.summary: A two hour group lesson for first timers or anyone returning after a break. It starts with ten to fifteen minutes on the beach covering the pop up, etiquette and safety, then the rest is in the water. The instructor picks the spot on the day to suit conditions, from Brandons, Dover, Pebbles, Sandy Beach or Freights Bay.
highlights: Small groups, no more than 4 students per instructor
Spot chosen on the day: Brandons, Dover, Pebbles, Sandy Beach or Freights Bay
Surfboard included; rashguards and reef boots on request
Two lessons daily, at 10 am and 2 pm

trips.title: Private/Beginner/Intermediate Surf Lesson
trips.summary: A one to one lesson for beginners, returning surfers or intermediates who want to move up a level. The instructor collects you, picks the best spot for the day and works on catching your own waves, reading the ocean, technique, turns and cutbacks. You choose a board from the shop's range or the instructor picks one for you.
highlights: One to one with a local qualified instructor
Pick up and drop off included
Spots include Brandons, Dover, Pebbles, Sandy Beach, Soupbowl, Batsrock, Sandylane, Maycocks, Freights bay, south point and Parlours

trips.title: Private/Advanced Surf Lessons
trips.summary: A private session for experienced surfers with the shop's pro, who paddles out with you and corrects habits holding back your surfing. You are driven to and from your hotel, and the spot is chosen on the day, often Brandons, Soupbowl or the west coast when it is breaking.
highlights: Paddle out with the shop's pro surfer

Spots include Brandons, Soupbowl and the west coast when it is breaking
Choose a board from the shop's range

trips.title: Surf Tours
trips.summary: Guided surf days around Barbados with local guides who know which spots work in which conditions. Tours are built around the waves you are comfortable with, and transport is included. Half day and full day options, or a custom tour on request.
highlights: Guides trained in First Aid and CPR

All transport, pick up and drop off included

trips.summary: Stand up paddle lessons for first timers and surf technique for more advanced paddlers. The shop's favourite tour crosses Carlisle Bay, with its sandy beach, flat water and mostly light winds.
